description: Calculate jitter (period perturbation, PPQ5) and shimmer (amplitude perturbation) from a sustained vowel. Normal jitter < 1.04%; normal shimmer < 3.81 dB. Elevated values indicate irregular vibration — associated with dysphonia. BEFORE CALLING: Confirm the user has a sustained vowel recording (/a/ held at comfortable pitch for 3+ s, minimal background noise). If not, explain what it is and ask them to record one. Do not pass connected speech or conversational audio.

sustainedVowelPath.description: Sustained vowel /a/ WAV file (/a/ held 3+ s at comfortable pitch)

name: vocametrix_calculate_jitter_shimmer
